Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results from the first step. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that the Zone 5 Military Museum is in Da Nang, the Planner erroneously classified Da Nang as being in "Southern Vietnam" (Miền Nam). Da Nang is actually located in the South Central Coast region (Nam Trung Bộ) of Vietnam. This geographical error in the first analysis step led to the incorrect final answer of "Southern Vietnam" instead of the correct "South Central Coast".
